description: Line budgets for each module of apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/, recorded at the post-split sizes and checked by scripts/check_flow_module_budgets.py (run by 'uv run task lint'). A module may shrink but never grow past its budget. Budgets of child_progress.py, stages/calibrate.py and stages/intent.py were raised by 1, 1 and 3 lines for the ref_names helpers that build and name the /_ and /calibrated branches. Budgets of stages/intent.py, stages/plan.py, stages/execute.py, review/resolver.py and git_refs.py were also raised for the host-side fetch and push that moved every remote operation of a stage out of the role containers (host_remote.py owns them). Budgets of stages/decomposition.py and stages/children.py were raised by 4 and 2 lines to report a child branch name that cannot fit as a Stage 3 failure and to record original_slug on shortened child intents. The budget of review/loop.py was raised by 3 lines so the reviewed-commit lookup skips the fetch in a mounted role container (the host fetches before dispatch) and imports the one shared mounted-workspace check. The budget of __init__.py was raised by 2 lines to re-export build_review_id from the new review/ids.py module, as the package export test requires, and the budget of review/loop.py by 1 more line to keep the summary-record comment above the new review id call. The budget of stages/plan.py was raised by 5 lines to import the shared PLAN_FILE_PATTERN from entrypoint/planner.py (wrapped import) so the plan-stage validator and the planner share one plan-file regex. The budget of stages/plan_decision.py was raised by 1 line to import the same constant for its back-fill path-shape check. Lower a budget by hand after shrinking a module; add an entry at creation size for a new module and remove the entry of a deleted one.
